name: naphazoline + povidone + propylene glycol
purpose: Purpose Naphazoline hydrochloride - Redness reliever Povidone – Lubricant Propylene glycol - Lubricant
uses: Uses relieves redness of the eye due to minor eye irritations temporarily relieves burning and irritation due to dryness of the eye
